purpose: MAT-002: accepted, versioned, conflict-tested TR/EN reviewed-synonym dictionary for the reviewed_synonyms adapter stage of match_term(). Every accepted pair was reviewed for genuine equivalence (not just co-occurrence); rejected candidate pairs are recorded with a reason so a future reviewer does not re-propose them without new evidence.

abstained.reason: SAP is one specific vendor's ERP product, not a generic synonym for the ERP category; treating them as interchangeable would let a candidate's SAP experience wrongly satisfy a requirement for a different ERP system (or vice versa).

Customs brokerage (gümrük) is a narrower discipline than logistics (lojistik) as a whole; frequent co-occurrence in job postings is not the same as equivalence, so this pair is not accepted as a synonym.
A master's degree and a PhD are different, non-interchangeable education levels; accepting this pair would let a master's-only candidate falsely satisfy a PhD requirement.
